turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My team plays at home on Saturday afternoon and my girlfriend's coming for the first time. She's not into football.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then make the day about more than the match. A nice lunch near the ground first, and explain a few basics on the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I need to pick a cake for my sister's fortieth and the bakery sent me a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a three tier sponge with fresh flowers on top, beautiful but really pricey.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They also do a cheesecake tower, which she'd love because she hates icing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a tray of forty little cupcakes, each with a different topping, so everyone grabs their own.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all the options I've got, Moshi. Be honest, which is best?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The flower sponge would look stunning in photos, but if she hates icing she might barely eat it. The cheesecake tower is the one built around her taste. Cupcakes are the easiest to serve, though they feel a bit less like a centrepiece.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Who the big players are, what the rivalry is, and why this game matters. A story makes it fun to watch.
